docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,211.44 FILED BY PARAMOUNT EQUIPMENT LEASING AS TO DEFENDANT ALEXANDER AUTO WRECKING ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-19-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
